title: WhatsApp Introduces Scheduled Messages Feature
excerpt: WhatsApp is rolling out a new scheduled messages feature for its three billion users across both private and group chats.
body_html:
WhatsApp is rolling out a new feature that allows its three billion users to schedule messages in advance. According to Meta, this capability is among the platform's most requested additions.

The new scheduling option functions in both private conversations and group chats, enabling users to choose a specific time to send messages.
